summary: 扩散/时序:具自主执行力的agents与企业规模采用直到2024-25才起步(生产用AI 2023/9仅3.7%→2025/9约10%;可靠时程仅~50分钟),而任务暴露潜力达47-56%——'暴露≠已实现',给'太早/滞后'解读强机制先验。

evidence.title: Census BTOS adoption
evidence.quote: the number of businesses using AI rose from 3.7% in September 2023 to 5.4% in February 2024
evidence.note: 采用刚起步、绝对水平低

evidence.title: GPTs are GPTs (exposure ceiling)
evidence.quote: this share increases to between 47 and 56% of all tasks
evidence.note: 暴露潜力远高于已实现采用

evidence.title: METR time horizon
evidence.quote: 50% success horizon for frontier models at ~50 minutes on human expert tasks
evidence.note: 自主执行力刚过低阈值

open_questions: 采用曲线是否会因agent成熟出现非线性跃升,把滞后效应集中释放?
